'''Fighter Red''', otherwise known as '''Red E Squadron''' or simply '''Red Squadron''', was a squadron of [[E-7 E-wing multi-role starfighter|E-wing escort starfighters]] assigned to the [[Endurance-class fleet carrier|''Endurance''-class fleet carrier]] [[Intrepid (Endurance-class)|''Intrepid'']] of the [[New Republic Defense Fleet/Legends|New Republic Defense Fleet]] [[New Republic Fifth Fleet|Fifth Battle Group]].

It was the elite interceptor squadron of the carrier, and [[General/Legends|General]] [[Etahn A'baht]]'s personal E-wing was stationed in Fighter Red.

Immediately prior to the [[Battle of Doornik-319|Battle of Doornik 319]], Fighter Red was one of the squadrons prepared for immediate launch aboard the ''Intrepid'', and when the ''Intrepid'' entered the system, Fighter Red was part of the fleet carrier's fighter screen, and presumably participated in the ensuing battle during the [[Yevetha]]n ambush. Later, during the preparations for the final assault on N'zoth, General A'baht offered command of the squadron to [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] for the [[Battle of N'zoth]], but Skywalker demurred.
